# @stolyarovmn/dsh-client-ui-schedule-tab 0.6.15

Review build for DSH `0.1.7-rc.2`.

## Scope

Visual-compliance pass only. This build deliberately does **not** rewrite the existing native-detail bridge, slot-entry reuse, DOM observation, or rc2 client-internal integration. Those known architectural deviations remain in the `0.6.x` line.

## Changed

- First-level title typography and page insets now follow the native DSH Schedule page more closely.
- Filter controls use the native quiet 28px pill-tab visual treatment.
- Ordinary cards/controls use the DSH semantic radius tokens instead of local 7/8/9/12px radii.
- Intentional pills and circular status dots explicitly keep round geometry.
- Literal `#111` fallbacks were removed in favor of DSH theme tokens.
- Keyboard focus rings use the shared DSH focus-ring variables.
- The native-detail loading placeholder is localized instead of hardcoded in English.
- Russian notification-setting copy was polished.

No npm publish requested.
